title: Business-software cohort
scope: Established business software / SaaS seed cohort, including midmarket. Source is a historical 2021 ranking, not current headcount or independent verification of enterprise sales. Acquired brands and older domains remain; domains are not necessarily distinct corporate parents. DNS is queried live.
selection: First 1,000 distinct normalized domains ranked by source historical employee count after exclusions; 800 discovery / 200 holdout assigned by SHA-256 domain order before scanning.
